messages.最も左のスロットで同じスキルを連続して使い、組札を合わせ続けて光札を5まで貯め、: A Tremor and Sinking Identity that repeatedly uses the same skill in her leftmost slot to keep matching card combinations, building 5 Bright cards for maximum-Power Kōzan [光斬] follow-ups. Discard helps arrange the required hand.
messages.組札は前のターンのスキルに変わる: パッシブ「こいこい」により、最も左のスロット: **The Hand changes to match the previous turn's skill**: Through the passive Koi-Koi [こいこい], from the next turn the Hand changes to the one matching the skill used in her leftmost slot (Pine Crane = S1, Wrath; Susuki Grass = S2, Sloth; Blue Sakura = S3, Gloom). Using a skill of the same Sin as the Hand gives +1 Bright【光】 Potency, and +1 more if it also matched on the previous turn. It triggers Tremor Burst on hit.
messages.捨てる: S1〜S3は使用時、同じスロットの装着していないスキルが異なるなら捨て: **Discard**: On use, S1–S3 discard the unequipped skill in the same slot if it is different. This makes identical skills line up in hand more easily, helping consecutive use.
messages.光札と制限時間: 光札は威力0〜5、回数3で、回数はターン開始時に1減る。威力1: **Bright and its time limit**: Bright has Potency 0–5 and Count 3, and Count decreases by 1 at Turn Start. +1 Offense Level Up at Turn Start per Potency. At the end of her leftmost slot's skill, if Potency is 5 or Count is 0, Kōzan [光斬] triggers.
messages.光札を足す手段: 「桜閃」かE.G.Oスキルを最も左のスロットで使うと、組札に関: **Ways to add Bright**: Using Sakura-sen [桜閃] or an E.G.O skill in the leftmost slot gives +1 Bright Potency regardless of the Hand. The Defense skill Shuffle Hands - Floral Deck has a 50% chance of +1 Bright Potency at Combat Start, once per turn.
messages.「光斬」: 光札威力3未満ならキャンセルされ、次のターンに攻撃威力増加2を得る。: **Kōzan [光斬]**: Cancelled if Bright Potency is below 3, granting 2 Attack Power Up next turn. At 3 or more, +10% damage per Potency, reusing a Coin (Bright Potency − 1) times. At 5, the last reused Coin triggers Tremor Burst twice on hit. After use, the Hand changes randomly.
messages.最も左のスロットで同じスキルを毎ターン使い、組札を合わせ続けて1回目+1、2回目: Use the same skill in her leftmost slot every turn to keep matching the Hand, building Bright at +1 the first time and +2 from the second time on, and fire Kōzan at Potency 5 before Count runs out. The basic pattern is spamming S1, her most-held skill, three times from the start (with the Pine Crane Hand, 1→2→2 reaches 5 Bright on turn 3). There is also a route starting from Sakura-sen or a Gloom E.G.O when the Hand is Blue Sakura, but it takes more turns to reach Kōzan, and Bright's 3 Count may run out so Kōzan triggers below Potency 5 (the order of decrease and trigger cannot be determined from the data), so limit it to when conditions line up. When her hand does not cooperate, equipping Shuffle Hands - Floral Deck in the leftmost slot randomly changes the next turn's Hand to one different from the current one.
